title: Breasts and Nipples
summary: Breasts are made of fat, glandular and connective tissue. Nipples and areolas vary widely in size, colour and shape, and are erogenous for many people of any sex.
key_points: Breast tenderness often changes with the menstrual cycle.
A new lump, nipple discharge or skin dimpling should be checked by a doctor.
